## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --no-default-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --no-default-features`

- [ ] No secret, private dataset, or unbounded resource was added
- [ ] Commit sign-offs satisfy the DCO in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
